Ayodhya Temple Controversy: RSS Expresses Hurt, Legal Actions Demanded

The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) has broken its silence on an alleged theft at the Ayodhya temple, expressing deep hurt and demanding severe punishment for those responsible. Meanwhile, lawyers have sought First Information Reports (FIRs) against Champat Rai and Gopal Rao, organizing a protest in Ayodhya. Another accusation has emerged from within the temple administration, with its head alleging an 'illegal' takeover by Champat Rai.
